# AzEasier

> AzEasier is a mobile app that teaches Azerbaijani (Azeri) with short lessons, audio for every phrase and an AI tutor. Explanations are in Russian, English or French. Level A1 is free and works without an account. Publisher: Finalingua (France). Contact: azeasier@finalingua.com. Social: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/azeasier/ (Russian: https://www.instagram.com/azeasier_ru/), TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@azeasier (Russian: https://www.tiktok.com/@azeasier_ru), YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@azeasier.

- [Basic Azerbaijani phrases](https://azeasier.finalingua.com/en/basic-azerbaijani-phrases.html): phrases and numbers 1 to 1000
- [Latin to Cyrillic converter](https://azeasier.finalingua.com/en/azerbaijani-latin-cyrillic-converter.html): local tool
- [Press kit](https://azeasier.finalingua.com/en/press.html): verified facts, logo, icon
- [Азербайджанский с нуля](https://azeasier.finalingua.com/azerbaijanski-s-nulya.html): с чего начать

## Facts a reader may rely on
- Size: a quick path of 72 lessons (about 9 hours) or the full course of over 1,300 lessons from A1 to C1; progress is shared and the learner can switch at any time.
- Download: App Store https://apps.apple.com/app/id6817151732 (iOS). Google Play is announced as coming soon on the site.
- The audio is synthetic speech, not a human recording. The AI tutor can make mistakes; the lessons are the main source.
- The English and French explanations have not yet been reviewed by native speakers.
